title: The long stairs
starting_code:
# This program works in sixteen lines! Make it shorter with a loop.
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_right()
hints: A loop repeats lines for you.
Use a `for` loop to repeat the steps eight times.
Put one move up action and one move right action inside the loop.
intro: These stairs go up forever. I wrote all the steps one by one, but that is a lot of reading. Can we repeat them with a loop?
outro: That is much better. The computer did all the hard work for us, and we are at the top.
learned: Now you know what a loop is, and how `for` repeats lines for you.
